moworks.notes: Stepped at 24 fps. At 0.4 s the word (66 px) scales 3 → 1 linearly in 4 frames; landing frame: full-frame 22 % light flash; then seeded shake ±10 px × (1 − f / 8) for 8 frames. Word skewX −7°, rotated −3.4°; 9 px accent outline under a 3.5 px dark inner outline under the fill. From landing, 64 radial wedges (0.012–0.032 rad) from off-frame to an inner ellipse 74–120 px (×0.7 tall), grey 85 %, until the exit. Exit 2.05–2.35 s: fade, scale +15 %. Loop 2.6 s. Params: tỉ lệ đầu (300 %, 4 khung) · rung (±10 px, 8 khung) · số tia (64) · nhịp hình (24 fps). Stepped at 24 fps: 3 → 1 in four frames, a flash on the landing frame, then a seeded shake fading over eight frames.
